Ralph Unterzuyder, fourth generation descendant of the infamous Unterzuyders, emerged testily from the Glass & Sand Bldg. where he had just set up a law office under the name of Carruthers Straley. arxiv-1909-07079.creator: Huan Xiong, Mengyang Yu, Li Liu, Fan Zhu, Fumin Shen, Ling Shao
arxiv-1909-07079.description: Abstract Binary optimization, a representative subclass of discrete optimization, plays an important role in mathematical optimization and has various applications in computer vision and machine learning. Usually, binary optimization problems are NP-hard and difficult to solve due to the binary constraints, especially when the number of variables is very large.

arxiv-2109-09832.title: Weak Signals in the Mobility Landscape: Car Sharing in Ten European Cities
arxiv-2109-09832.creator: CBChiara Boldrini, RBRaffaele Bruno, HLHaitam Laarabi
arxiv-2109-09832.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by CBChiara Boldrini, RBRaffaele Bruno, HLHaitam Laarabi. \justify Car sharing is one the pillars of a smart transportation infrastructure, as it is expected to reduce traffic congestion, parking demands and pollution in our cities. From the point of view of demand modelling, car sharing is a weak signal in the city landscape: only a small percentage of the population uses it, and thus it is difficult to study reliably with traditional techniques such as households travel diaries.

arxiv-2204-12539.title: Automation of radiation treatment planning for rectal cancer
arxiv-2204-12539.creator: Kai Huang, Prajnan Das, Adenike M. Olanrewaju, Carlos Cardenas, David Fuentes, Lifei Zhang, Donald Hancock, Hannah Simonds, Dong Joo Rhee, Sam Beddar, Tina Marie Briere, Laurence Court
arxiv-2204-12539.description: Abstract To develop an automated workflow for rectal cancer three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy (3DCRT) treatment planning that combines deep learning (DL) aperture predictions and forward-planning algorithms. We designed an algorithm to automate the clinical workflow for 3DCRT planning with field aperture creations and field-in-field (FIF) planning.

arxiv-2306-03606.title: BioBLP: A Modular Framework for Learning on Multimodal Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-2306-03606.creator: Daniel Daza, Dimitrios Alivanistos, Payal Mitra, Thom Pijnenburg, Michael Cochez, Paul Groth
arxiv-2306-03606.description: Abstract Background: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are an important tool for representing complex relationships between entities in the biomedical domain. Several methods have been proposed for learning embeddings that can be used to predict new links in such graphs. Some methods ignore valuable attribute data associated with entities in biomedical KGs, such as protein sequences, or molecular graphs.

arxiv-2402-01092.title: A Dynamical Model of Neural Scaling Laws
arxiv-2402-01092.creator: Blake Bordelon, Alexander Atanasov, Cengiz Pehlevan
arxiv-2402-01092.description: Abstract On a variety of tasks, the performance of neural networks predictably improves with training time, dataset size and model size across many orders of magnitude. This phenomenon is known as a neural scaling law. Of fundamental importance is the compute-optimal scaling law, which reports the performance as a function of units of compute when choosing model sizes optimally.

arxiv-2406-18977.title: RoboUniView : Visual-Language Model with Unified View Representation for Robotic Manipulation
arxiv-2406-18977.creator: Fanfan Liu, Feng Yan, Liming Zheng, Chengjian Feng, Yiyang Huang, Lin Ma
arxiv-2406-18977.description: Abstract Utilizing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for robotic manipulation represents a novel paradigm, aiming to enhance the model’s ability to generalize to new objects and instructions. However, due to variations in camera specifications and mounting positions, existing methods exhibit significant performance disparities across different robotic platforms.

arxiv-2502-20096.title: Disentangling by random pulses
arxiv-2502-20096.creator: Henryk Gzyl
arxiv-2502-20096.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Henryk Gzyl. Here we propose an analytically tractable model of an entangled quantum state subject to random shocks and prove that disentanglement occurs asymptotically. The system consists of two identical, two level state systems, say two entangled qubits or two entangled two state molecules, and the heat bath consists of the occurrence of state switching shocks, which happen at a Poisson rate.

While existing methods perform well on short videos, they often struggle with long-range reasoning in longer videos.

britannica-1911-buenos-aires-city.description: Article 'Buenos Aires (city)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 4), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The prevailing style of domestic architecture is that introduced from Spain and used throughout all the Spanish colonies—the grouping of one-storey buildings round one or two patios, which open on the street through a wide doorway. These residences have heavily barred windows on the street, and flat roofs with  parapets admirably adapted for defence.

pmc-10629054.creator: Emmanuel K Tetteh, Elvin H Geng, Mark D Huffman
pmc-10629054.description: BackgroundAs a relatively new field, dissemination and implementation research has not been included as a separate study design category for ethical consideration compared with clinical and social/behavioral research, yet it should be based on unique study designs, targets of intervention, and corresponding risks.

pmc-10682017.title: Evaluation of online learning readiness in the new distance learning normality
pmc-10682017.creator: Maribell Reyes-Millán, Myriam Villareal-Rodríguez, M Estela Murrieta-Flores, Ligia Bedolla-Cornejo, Patricia Vázquez-Villegas, Jorge Membrillo-Hernández
pmc-10682017.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The COVID-19 pandemic influenced teaching and learning in higher education. The transformation towards digital education challenged Faculty and students. This research examines the online learning readiness of students in a Higher Education Institution in Mexico. Specifically, we investigated how much prior digital skills, as well as having used the digital resources available by the university, influenced their academic achievement in distance learning settings. Seven dimensions of online learning readiness were selected to evaluate the student's preparation for the online learning process.

pmc-11315280.title: Citrate serves as a signal molecule to modulate carbon metabolism and iron homeostasis in Staphylococcus aureus
pmc-11315280.creator: Feifei Chen, Qingmin Zhao, Ziqiong Yang, Rongrong Chen, Huiwen Pan, Yanhui Wang, Huan Liu, Qiao Cao, Jianhua Gan, Xia Liu, Naixia Zhang, Cai-Guang Yang, Haihua Liang, Lefu Lan, Andreas Peschel, Michael Otto, Andreas Peschel, Michael Otto, Andreas Peschel, Michael Otto, Andreas Peschel, Michael Otto
pmc-11315280.description: Pathogenic bacteria’s metabolic adaptation for survival and proliferation within hosts is a crucial aspect of bacterial pathogenesis. Here, we demonstrate that citrate, the first intermediate of the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle, plays a key role as a regulator of gene expression in Staphylococcus aureus.

pmc-11372232.description: In patients with unilateral mandibular condyle hyperplasia, whether to perform condylectomy and orthognathic surgical procedures at the same time or orthognathic surgery in two stages for remains controversial. Reported here is a case of facial asymmetry with mandibular condyle hyperplasia, for which condylectomy and orthognathic surgery procedures were performed at the same time.

pmc-11404179.title: Electroacupuncture versus solifenacin succinate for female overactive bladder: study protocol for a multicentre, randomised, controlled, double-dummy, non-inferiority trial
pmc-11404179.creator: Bingli Chen, Ping Yin, Juanjuan Li, Wenguang Hou, Qian Fan, Yisheng Huai, Lumin Liu, Junwei Hu, Sandra Teresa Chow, Xu Li, Shuren Ming, Yue-Lai Chen
pmc-11404179.description: IntroductionOveractive bladder (OAB) affects approximately 500 million people worldwide, with a higher prevalence in women than in men, significantly impacting the quality of life of female patients. Treatment options for OAB are currently limited. Previous research has proposed that electroacupuncture could be a viable treatment for OAB in women, but there is a lack of high-quality clinical evidence.

pmc-12751562.title: Circulating T-cell receptor repertoire and clinicopathological correlations in breast cancer patients: immune repertoire analysis from the VGH-TAYLOR study
pmc-12751562.creator: Ling-Ming Tseng, Chi-Cheng Huang, Ji-Lin Chen, Yi-Fang Tsai, Ta-Chung Chao, Wen-Chi Wu, Pei-Ju Lien, Yen-Shu Lin, Chin-Jung Feng, Yen-Jen Chen, Jiun-I. Lai, Jen-Hwey Chiu, Chih-Yi Hsu, Chun-Yu Liu
pmc-12751562.description: Sequencing of the T-cell receptor (TCR) repertoire can reflect immune status and monitor treatment responses. Here, we aimed to characterize the TCRβ repertoire and its correlation with clinical and prognostic significance in breast cancer. A total of 856 peripheral blood samples were collected from female breast cancer patients for TCR sequencing.

pmc-12951384.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/AimEndometrial cancer (EC) is an important health issue among women, with immunotherapy emerging as a promising option for advanced cases. Tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) and immune checkpoints, including PDCD1, CD274, and PDCD1LG2, are increasingly recognized as prognostic markers.

pmc-13054235.title: Behavioral Selection of Coprophagy in an Arid‐Adapted Herbivore: Does a Compatibility–Risk Gradient Shape Selective Coprophagy?
pmc-13054235.creator: Christin Moeller, Scott E Henke, Sandra Rideout‐Hanzak, Cord B Eversole
pmc-13054235.description: Coprophagy is widespread among herbivores but remains poorly understood in reptiles, where its ecological function has rarely been tested. We conducted controlled choice experiments with 25 adult Texas tortoises ( Gopherus berlandieri ), an arid‐adapted hindgut fermenter, to determine whether feces consumption represents incidental ingestion or a selective behavioral strategy.

pmc-13216129.creator: Miaomiao Fan, Mengyang Wang, Huiying Chen, Shujuan Lin, Hao Bai, Hui Han, Liyong Chen
pmc-13216129.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). hat IBD is associated with a complex multifactorial etiology that includes genetic predisposition, environmental exposures, gut microbiota, and immune dysregulation [1]. Emerging evidence highlights that metabolic dysregulation is also a key player in IBD pathogenesis [2]. Circulating metabolites, which reflect the integrated influence of environmental, genetic, and microbiome factors, provide a powerful framework for uncovering mechanistic links between diverse biological pathways and disease phenotypes [3], thereby facilitating biomarker discovery and advancing the understanding of IBD pathogenesis and progression.

uslaw-usc-t15-s1293.title: 15 U.S.C. § 1293 — Intercollegiate and interscholastic football contest limitations
uslaw-usc-t15-s1293.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s1293.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 32 (Telecasting Of Professional Sports Contests). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The first sentence of section 1291 of this title shall not apply to any joint agreement described in such section which permits the telecasting of all or a substantial part of any professional football game on any Friday after six o’clock postmeridian.
